color.note: Dark is the primary theme. Rope amber is the only accent; every other colour is ink or paper.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Terminal panels, the install bar, code blocks. One step off bg; never nested.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on bg or surface (15.4:1 dark, 14.6:1 light on bg).

tokens.name: fg-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, comments in code (6.5:1 dark, 5.3:1 light on bg).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and panel outlines. Decorative only: never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Rope amber. The primary action, the install bar outline, active states, prompts ($). Text-safe on bg and surface (8.6:1 dark, 5.8:1 light).

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of the primary action.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus ring with 2px offset. Ink, not amber, so it shows on an amber button.

tokens.name: logo-ink
tokens.usage: Ink of the hand-drawn logo. Logo only; use fg for UI.

tokens.name: logo-rope
tokens.usage: Rope of the hand-drawn logo. Logo only; #a3672a fails as text on light bg (4.0:1), use accent.

groups.name: Sans
groups.note: Prose and headings. Two weights do the work: 400 and 600.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: A controller for your AI coding agents.
styles.usage: The one page headline. Fluid: clamp(40px, 5vw, 68px).

styles.name: heading
styles.sample: Nothing is guessed from terminal text.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Describe the work to one PM agent.
styles.usage: The paragraph under the headline, in fg-muted with fg emphasis.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A report names a full commit id.

groups.name: Mono
groups.note: Commands, branch names, ids and labels. Anything a person could type is mono.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks, nav links, the dashboard table.

spacing.note: A 4px scale. Use only these steps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text, tight insets.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Table cell vertical padding, small gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Header cell padding, caption offsets.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel inset, mobile page gutter, row padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button side padding, grid gaps, nav gaps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Column gaps.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter, gaps between hero blocks.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Large section breaks on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Rules, table rows, full-bleed bands.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Inline code, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Buttons, the install bar, panels, focus rings.

duration.note: Motion only confirms an action (hover, copy feedback). Easing for all: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1), an ease-out. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover colour changes, button press.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Copy feedback fade, state swaps.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Every transition and the copy feedback.

textSize.note: Font sizes as variables, for CSS that sets size apart from the type-style classes.

tokens.name: text-display
tokens.usage: The page headline; 68px at desktop.

tokens.name: text-heading
tokens.usage: Section headings.

tokens.name: text-lead
tokens.usage: Lead paragraph.

tokens.name: text-body
tokens.usage: Body text.

tokens.name: text-command
tokens.usage: The install command.

tokens.name: text-code
tokens.usage: Code, nav, buttons, the dashboard table.

tokens.name: text-label
tokens.usage: Table headers, captions, footers, the copy status line.
